meta.title: ACCSYSTEM School Platform Renderer Specification Tree
meta.description: Comprehensive structural, mandatory, optional, and test requirements guide for all blocks and sections in the rendering engine.

headline.name: Headline Block
headline.description: Renders primary/secondary heading text element with responsive context typography.
test_requirements: Assert target text matches fields.text
Assert 'block-headline--featured' when config.is_featured is true

subheadline.name: Subheadline Block
subheadline.description: Renders lead paragraph text or section subtitle.
test_requirements: Assert text renders in .block-subheadline

fields.text: Comprehensive tools built for modern schools.

label.name: Label / Tag Block
label.description: Renders category badge or eyebrow text.
test_requirements: Assert label text renders inside badge tag

rich_text.name: Rich Text Block
rich_text.description: Renders HTML or formatted node structure for longform body prose.

mandatory_fields.name: content
mandatory_fields.rule: Formatted prose string or node document.

test_requirements: Assert HTML nodes render safely without breaking DOM layout

quote.name: Quote Block
quote.description: Renders pull quote with attribution author and title.
test_requirements: Assert quote body renders inside blockquote
Assert attribution renders if present

cta.name: Call to Action Block
cta.description: Renders interactive button linking to an internal/external route.
test_requirements: Assert destination route matches destination.value
Assert label text matches fields.label

platform_card.name: Platform Card Block
platform_card.description: Renders platform module card with role, status badge, description, and link.
test_requirements: Assert card title matches display_name
Assert status badge renders when site_status is not 'live'

product_gateway_cta.name: Product Gateway CTA Block
product_gateway_cta.description: Conversion callout container with dual primary and secondary actions.
test_requirements: Assert headline and actions render inside callout container

person_card.name: Person Card Block
person_card.description: Renders staff or team member card with avatar and bio.
test_requirements: Assert person name renders in h3 title
Assert media image renders avatar when present

feature_item.name: Feature Item Block
feature_item.description: Single feature entry with title, description, and optional icon.
test_requirements: Assert label and description text render accurately

stat_item.name: Stat Item Block
stat_item.description: Numerical metric, unit suffix, and descriptor callout.
test_requirements: Assert metric value and descriptor render

media.name: Media Block
media.description: Renders image asset with alt text and responsive srcset variants.
test_requirements: Assert img src matches media variant URL

media_group.name: Media Group Block
media_group.description: Gallery or cluster of multiple media items.
test_requirements: Assert media items render inside grid container

form_definition.name: Form Definition Block
form_definition.description: Interactive dynamic form with input fields and submission state.
test_requirements: Assert inputs render for each field item
Assert success message replaces form upon submit

capability_card.name: Capability Card Block
capability_card.description: Capability summary tile with title and description.
test_requirements: Assert label and description text render

use_case_card.name: Use Case Card Block
use_case_card.description: Solution scenario card with headline, narrative, and tags.
test_requirements: Assert headline and narrative render
Assert tags render when present

fields.headline: Multi-site Management
fields.scenario_narrative: Centralized controls for multiple school campuses.

industry_card.name: Industry Card Block
industry_card.description: Industry segment tile with title, summary, and platforms list.
test_requirements: Assert industry name and platforms tags render

platform_recommendation.name: Platform Recommendation Block
platform_recommendation.description: Recommendation callout tile for matching platform products.
test_requirements: Assert platform_name renders in tile header

pricing_tier_card.name: Pricing Tier Card Block
pricing_tier_card.description: Pricing plan column with tier name, price, feature checklist, and buy button.
test_requirements: Assert price and tier name render
Assert feature checklist items render

feature_row.name: Feature Row Block
feature_row.description: Comparison table matrix row mapping feature to tier values.
test_requirements: Assert feature_name renders in row label
Assert tier values map across columns

video_embed.name: Video Embed Block
test_requirements: Assert iframe src matches video_url

breadcrumb_trail.name: Breadcrumb Trail Block
test_requirements: Assert path entries render in sequence with separators

customer_story_card.name: Customer Story Card Block
customer_story_card.description: Case study card featuring company, headline, and metric.
test_requirements: Assert company name and headline quote render

blog_post_card.name: Blog Post Card Block
blog_post_card.description: News article summary card with title, author, date, category tag, and summary.
test_requirements: Assert article title and summary render

nav_link.name: Navigation Link Block
nav_link.description: Single link item inside navigation containers.
test_requirements: Assert navigation link label and url render

unknown.name: Unknown Block Fallback
unknown.description: Fallback block renderer for unregistered block types.
test_requirements: Assert renders graceful fallback without crashing

caption.name: Caption Block
caption.description: Renders image caption or footnote text (uses LabelBlock component).
test_requirements: Assert caption text renders inside caption element
